name: skeetin
title: SkeetIn
blurb: bluesky reskinned as linkedin: the same posts and follower counts, rendered as a corporate professional network — likes become Endorsements, reposts become Reposted this, replies become Comments. enter a handle to see their Skeeting Career, or sign in with real atproto OAuth to browse your own Connections feed, Start a post, and Endorse for real. @antiali.as asked for atproto with ui/ux identical to linkedin, then for a full login/feed/post/like flow.
